# @sharadox/consent-web-library

> Cookie consent: Accept All/manual kept (localStorage), Deny only for the visit (sessionStorage), required always on, version bump re-asks; themable panel.

- Config: { storageKey, version, categories: [{ key, required? }] }
- /consent: readConsent(config) → { kind: unknown|declined|decided, record? }, saveConsent(config, granted), declineConsent(config), hasConsent(config, key), openConsent(), requiredOnly(config), everything(config), CONSENT_CHANGE_EVENT, CONSENT_OPEN_EVENT
- /use-consent: useConsent(config) → { status (undefined before hydration), acceptAll, deny, save(granted) }
- /consent-panel: <ConsentPanel configuration copy={ title, text, acceptAll, deny, customize, save, back, close, alwaysOn, categories: { key: { title, text } } } className icon decoration />; CSS vars --consent-background/-foreground/-muted/-line/-radius/-font
- Peer: react. License: Sharadox Open Source License 0.1.0
- Panel CSS variables also include --consent-accent (the Accept All button's background: a color or a gradient; the foreground color by default) and --consent-accent-foreground (its text; the background color by default).
